data.one_liner: Extended nested scroll view to fix pinned header and inner scrollables sync issues.
data.what_it_does: Provides an extended NestedScrollView to fix common synchronization issues with pinned sliver headers and inner scrollables inside tab views. It also allows building nested scroll views without needing a ScrollController in the body.
use_when: You need to fix pinned sliver header synchronization issues in Flutter's NestedScrollView
You have inner scrollables inside a TabView and need proper scroll position syncing
You want to manage scroll views inside a NestedScrollView body without custom ScrollControllers
avoid_when: Standard Flutter NestedScrollView meets all your layout requirements without header or sync bugs
strengths: Fixes known framework issues with pinned headers and inner scrollables
Provides ExtendedVisibilityDetector to track visible lists
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Depends on overriding or extending core framework scrolling behavior which may require updates with new Flutter releases
